an5.113:1.1: “Meditators, a meditator who has five qualities can’t enter and dwell in right {{concentration}}.
an5.113:1.3: It’s when a meditator can’t endure sights, sounds, smells, tastes, and touches.
an5.113:1.4: A meditator who possesses these five qualities can’t enter and dwell in right {{concentration}}.
an5.113:2.1: A meditator who has five qualities can enter and dwell in right {{concentration}}.
an5.113:2.3: It’s when a meditator can endure sights, sounds, smells, tastes, and touches.
an5.113:2.4: A meditator who possesses these five qualities can enter and dwell in right {{concentration}}.”
